entries.title: Proverbs 6:1
segments: ¶My son, if you become surety for your friend, [If] you have shaken hands in pledge for a stranger,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:2
segments: You are snared by the words of your mouth; You are taken by the words of your mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:3
segments: So do this, my son, and deliver yourself; For you have come into the hand of your friend: Go and humble yourself; Plead with your friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:4
segments: Give no sleep to your eyes, Nor slumber to your eyelids.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:5
segments: Deliver yourself like a gazelle from the hand [of the hunter], And like a bird from the hand of the fowler.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:6
segments: ¶Go to the ant, you sluggard! Consider her ways and be wise,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:7
segments: Which, having no captain, Overseer or ruler,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:8
segments: Provides her supplies in the summer, [And] gathers her food in the harvest.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:9
segments: How long will you slumber, O sluggard? When will you rise from your sleep?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:10
segments: A little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep-

entries.title: Proverbs 6:11
segments: So shall your poverty come on you like a prowler, And your need like an armed man.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:12
segments: ¶A worthless person, a wicked man, Walks with a perverse mouth;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:13
segments: He winks with his eyes, He shuffles his feet, He points with his fingers;

entries.title: Proverbs 6:14
segments: Perversity [is] in his heart, He devises evil continually, He sows discord.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:15
segments: Therefore his calamity shall come suddenly; Suddenly he shall be broken without remedy.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:16
segments: These six [things] the LORD hates, Yes, seven [are] an abomination to Him:

entries.title: Proverbs 6:17
segments: A proud look, A lying tongue, Hands that shed innocent blood,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:18
segments: A heart that devises wicked plans, Feet that are swift in running to evil,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:19
segments: A false witness [who] speaks lies, And one who sows discord among brethren.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:20
segments: ¶My son, keep your father's command, And do not forsake the law of your mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:21
segments: Bind them continually upon your heart; Tie them around your neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:22
segments: When you roam, they will lead you; When you sleep, they will keep you; And [when] you awake, they will speak with you.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:23
segments: For the commandment [is] a lamp, And the law a light; Reproofs of instruction [are] the way of life,

entries.title: Proverbs 6:24
segments: To keep you from the evil woman, From the flattering tongue of a seductress.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:25
segments: Do not lust after her beauty in your heart, Nor let her allure you with her eyelids.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:26
segments: For by means of a harlot [A man is reduced] to a crust of bread; And an adulteress will prey upon his precious life.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:27
segments: Can a man take fire to his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:28
segments: Can one walk on hot coals, And his feet not be seared?

entries.title: Proverbs 6:29
segments: So [is] he who goes in to his neighbor's wife; Whoever touches her shall not be innocent.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:30
segments: [People] do not despise a thief If he steals to satisfy himself when he is starving.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:31
segments: Yet [when] he is found, he must restore sevenfold; He may have to give up all the substance of his house.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:32
segments: Whoever commits adultery with a woman lacks understanding; He [who] does so destroys his own soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:33
segments: Wounds and dishonor he will get, And his reproach will not be wiped away.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:34
segments: For jealousy [is] a husband's fury; Therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

entries.title: Proverbs 6:35
segments: He will accept no recompense, Nor will he be appeased though you give many gifts.
